purpose: Measure whether Buddy is becoming independently capable rather than merely outsourcing successful tasks.

evidence_rules.independent: Requires successful execution without teacher-model completion for the evaluated task and documented environment.
evidence_rules.mastered: Requires repeated benchmark acceptance plus dependent-suite regression protection.
evidence_rules.gap_closed: Requires comparable baseline/reference evidence and a passing Buddy retest.
evidence_rules.blocked: Used when required dependency, permission, environment, or benchmark fixture is unavailable; never counted as pass.
